description: This PHP class 'ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser' provides functionality to guess the MIME type of a file based on its extension, implementing the 'MimeTypeGuesserInterface'.

classes.name: ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser
classes.description: A class that guesses MIME types based on file extensions, supporting only 'css' and 'js'.

methods.name: isGuesserSupported
methods.description: Returns true indicating that this MIME type guesser is supported.

methods.name: guessMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type based on the file's extension, returning 'text/css' for 'css' files and 'application/javascript' for 'js' files; returns null otherwise.
